description: This file contains functions for taking accessibility and role snapshots, navigating pages, resizing viewports, closing pages, and generating PDFs using Playwright, with a focus on accessibility and role-based snapshots.

methods.name: snapshotAriaViaPlaywright
methods.description: Captures an accessibility snapshot of the page's ARIA tree using Playwright.

methods.name: snapshotAiViaPlaywright
methods.description: Captures a snapshot of the page using Playwright's AI snapshot feature, with optional truncation.

methods.name: snapshotRoleViaPlaywright
methods.description: Captures a role or ARIA snapshot of the page, supporting selector/frame targeting and refs mode.

methods.name: navigateViaPlaywright
methods.description: Navigates the page to a specified URL with error handling and retries.

methods.name: resizeViewportViaPlaywright
methods.description: Resizes the browser viewport to specified dimensions.

methods.name: pdfViaPlaywright
methods.description: Generates a PDF buffer of the current page.
